description: This file contains controller functions for handling order-related operations in a backend application, including placing orders, verifying payments, retrieving user and all orders, and updating order status.

methods.name: placeOrder
methods.description: Handles creating a new order, saving it to the database, and initiating a Stripe checkout session.

methods.name: verifyOrder
methods.description: Verifies the payment status of an order and updates or deletes the order accordingly.

methods.name: userOrders
methods.description: Retrieves all orders associated with a specific user.

methods.name: listOrders
methods.description: Retrieves all orders in the system, typically for admin purposes.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific order.
